verdict.rationale: Missive documents canned responses (templates) that you write once, insert with a few keystrokes, and share with a team or the whole company (supp-4). A variables templating engine supports dynamic content such as the recipient's name (supp-5), and the changelog confirms {{ user.name }} and {{ user.email }} variables resolve in drafts (docs-50). Missing for 10: any evidence that templates can include attachments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of template insertion.
